notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The overhead cabinet has two separately moving door leaves, so they are reported separately. Their opening order is visible, but both closures occur within the same 592–600 sampling interval, making the individual closure ordering approximate.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens and later closes the refrigerator, separately opens both doors of an overhead cabinet above the range, and opens a top drawer beside the range. The cabinet doors and drawer are subsequently closed.
